# $\sigma$-algebra generated by a stopping time

Given a stopping time $\tau$ on a time index $T$, define $\mathcal{F}_\tau = \bigcap_{t \in T} \{A \in \mathcal{F} \mid A \cap \{\tau \le t\} \in \mathcal{F}_t\}.$
